testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Solution architects with experience across functional and technical disciplines of Microsoft Power Platform
recommended_experience: Experience in solution architecture across development, configuration, integration, infrastructure, security, licensing, storage, and change management

prerequisites.description: Solution architecture experience across functional and technical disciplines of Microsoft Power Platform
Knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, Dynamics 365 customer engagement apps, related Microsoft cloud solutions, and other third-party technologies

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: PL-600 is retired. Compare its historical blueprint with AB-100, see what transfers, and rebuild your plan around the current Microsoft exam.
editorial.overview: PL-600 was Microsoft's Microsoft Power Platform Solution Architect exam until its retirement on 2026-06-30. Its final published scope covered Perform solution envisioning and requirement analysis (45–50%), Architect a solution (35–40%), Implement the solution (15–20%). This page preserves that dated outline for historical comparison and curriculum cleanup. It is not a schedulable exam, and its prices, delivery details, registration links, and practice calls to action must not be used for a new certification plan.
editorial.who_should_take: Nobody should start a new certification plan around PL-600. This page serves former candidates, credential holders, training teams removing stale material, and practitioners deciding whether prior preparation is reusable for AB-100. New candidates should verify the active Microsoft page and current dated study guide before booking.
skills_summary: Preserve practical experience from Perform solution envisioning and requirement analysis (45–50%) only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Architect a solution (35–40%) only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
Preserve practical experience from Implement the solution (15–20%) only where the current guide shows meaningful overlap
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not rename an old PL-600 checklist or question bank as AB-100. Compare the two official guides objective by objective and classify each historical skill as transferable, changed, or absent. Use transferable experience as a diagnostic baseline, then rebuild labs and review around AB-100's current domain weights, products, role expectations, security controls, and operational tasks. Because Microsoft identifies AB-100 as the broader replacement path, review the skill map below before assuming equivalence.

domain_guidance.summary: Historically, Perform solution envisioning and requirement analysis (45–50%) required candidates to connect configuration choices with operational outcomes. The official outline included Initiate solution planning; Evaluate business requirements. Preserve hands-on understanding of those tasks where the successor comparison shows overlap, but do not treat this retired weighting or terminology as a current exam blueprint.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: PL-600 can no longer be scheduled. Use the active AB-100 certification page for current duration, languages, price, delivery, accommodations, and registration details, and verify them again immediately before booking.

methodology.summary: Cert Atlas compared Microsoft's final PL-600 study guide with the current AB-100 guide at the domain and objective level, then checked Microsoft's retirement list and transition announcement. OpenAI Codex assisted with extraction, normalization, comparison, and drafting. Claims were reviewed against the linked official sources; no exam stems, answers, choices, or explanations were used.

lifecycle.summary: Microsoft retired PL-600 and the Power Platform Solution Architect Expert certification on June 30, 2026. Microsoft describes AB-100 as a collective and partial replacement path that expands solution architecture into agentic AI business systems.
migration_actions: Stop scheduling, selling, or presenting PL-600 as a current exam.
Compare completed PL-600 preparation with the current AB-100 guide; do not carry over obsolete weighting or mechanics.
Create a fresh AB-100 plan around its current domains and hands-on role expectations.
Remove or quarantine practice content that cannot be mapped to a current objective with source evidence.
Recheck Microsoft's dated AB-100 study guide before booking because role-based exams change over time.

skill_comparison.change: Discovery skills transfer, with new emphasis on AI value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, responsible AI, and adoption.
Power Platform architecture remains relevant but expands to models, agents, orchestration, grounding, memory, tools, and cross-platform integration.
AB-100 puts substantially more weight on deployment governance, evaluation, security, observability, cost management, and lifecycle strategy.
